OCTOBER 16, 2025
Chief Forensics Reporter
School Fire Call Came Before Any Witness, Police Confirm
Detectives Trace a Single Line to rue Curial

A call about the school fire reached the Paris Emergency Switchboard at 20:58. The first witness saw flames 14 minutes later.

The call came from `LINE 4417`. The line is on the telephone company's bills, at the school's own address, 12 rue Curial. Detectives want to know which room the call was made from.
"That call came 14 minutes before any witness."
Every telephone line the telephone company bills: the subscriber, the room its telephone is in and at which hours, the street and the district. A `Flat` is where a caretaker lives on site.
A year at the Paris Emergency Switchboard: every call, sighting, alarm panel, patrol and fire engine in Paris, with the day and the hour it was written down.
The *Register*
Somebody pays a bill for `LINE 4417`. The telephone company lists every line it bills in `line_register`.
Instead of `*`, name the columns you want, separated by a comma. From `line_register`, show only the columns `line` and `subscriber`.
Every row of the register: 30 rows, 2 columns.
Join the *Two*
Both tables hold the line number: `source` in `dispatch_log`, `line` in `line_register`. In the register, `hours` says when the line's telephone is in that room.

Start from the calls, `FROM dispatch_log`. Then add `JOIN line_register ON source = line`: each call from a line in the register gets that line's room. Keep the calls of `2025-10-14`. Show only the time, the line, the room and its hours.
9 rows: the calls of that day from a billed line.
9 rows. A call with no line in the register isn't in the result. The 20:58 call appears 3 times: `LINE 4417` has 3 rooms.
Which *Room*
The early call came from `LINE 4417` at 20:58.
Join `dispatch_log` and `line_register` again. Which room was the call made from? Keep only that row, and only the columns `room` and `at_time`.
One row: the room and the time.
The `Lodge`. At 20:58, that line was the `Lodge` telephone.
`LINE 4417` has more than one row in `line_register`. Check each one against the day and the hour of the call.
Flames at 21:12 → `dispatch_log` → one school fire call before it: 20:58, `LINE 4417`.
